blocks.html:
The State of Tariffs

TODO (TK): final introduction copy. This tab introduces the dashboard, outlines its four analytical sections, and summarizes what has changed since the last update.

This tool consolidates the Budget Lab's up-to-date analysis of U.S. tariffs. It has four parts:

  • Daily Statutory Rates — the statutory tariff rate over time, overall and broken out by legal authority, trading partner, and product.
  • Default Scenario — the projected economic and fiscal effects of the default tariff policy scenario.
  • Alternative Scenarios — the same effects compared across all modeled policy scenarios.
  • Methodology — how these estimates are produced.

tabs.label: Daily Statutory Rates
tabs.description: Daily statutory U.S. tariff rates — overall, by authority, by trading partner, and by product. Rates are shown for one policy scenario at a time; the grey band marks dates that are future projections under current policy.

spec.title: Daily Statutory Tariff Rate — {scenario}
spec.subtitle: Import-weighted average statutory tariff rate. Percent.

figures.body_html:
The overall statutory tariff rate over time for the selected policy scenario. Dashed vertical lines mark major tariff-policy changes; the grey band marks the projected period.

Policy-change markers and the projection band are defined in data/statutory-rates/events.yaml (placeholder values, to be updated by the modelers).

spec.title: Statutory Tariff Rate by Authority — {scenario}
spec.subtitle: Import-weighted statutory rate, decomposed by tariff authority. Percent.

figures.body_html: The daily statutory rate decomposed into its contributing authorities, stacked on the base (MFN) rate. The series sum to the overall rate shown in the previous figure.

spec.title: Statutory Tariff Rate by Trading Partner — {scenario}
spec.subtitle: Import-weighted statutory rate on imports from each partner. Percent.

figures.body_html: The daily statutory rate by trading-partner group for the selected policy scenario.

spec.title: Statutory Tariff Rate for Selected Products — {scenario}
spec.subtitle: Import-weighted statutory rate by GTAP sector. Percent.
spec.note: A representative subset of GTAP sectors is shown.

figures.body_html: The daily statutory rate for a representative subset of products (GTAP sectors) for the selected policy scenario. series_order selects which sectors render — swap in other GTAP sector names to change the set.

tabs.label: Default Scenario
tabs.description: Projected effects of the default tariff policy scenario, following The State of U.S. Tariffs. Estimates are shown pre- and post-substitution (before and after consumers and businesses shift purchases in response to tariffs).

spec.subtitle: Projected effects of the default tariff policy scenario.

Default Scenario

TODO (TK): overview copy for the default policy scenario.

The figures in this section follow The State of U.S. Tariffs. They show the projected effects of the default tariff policy scenario. Where relevant, estimates are reported both pre-substitution (before consumers and businesses shift their purchases in response to tariffs) and post-substitution (after they shift).

spec.title: Average Effective Tariff Rate by Trading Partner
spec.subtitle: Change from baseline at the end of 2026, pre- and post-substitution. Percent.
spec.source: GTAP v7 [Corong et al (2017)], GTAP-RD, The Budget Lab analysis.

figures.body_html: A country-level breakdown of the average effective U.S. tariff rate, shown before and after trade substitution. The total row is bold.

spec.title: Consumer Price Effects by Spending Category
spec.subtitle: Percent change in consumer prices, pre- and post-substitution.
spec.source: BEA, GTAP v7, The Budget Lab analysis.
x_order: Food and beverages purchased for off-premises consumption

figures.body_html:
The estimated consumer-price effect by PCE spending category, ordered by spending group (durable goods, nondurable goods, services), with the total at the top.

spec.title: Distributional Effect by Income Decile
spec.subtitle: Tariff burden by household income decile.
spec.source: GTAP v7, Census, BLS, BEA, The Budget Lab analysis.

figures.body_html: The tariff burden by household income decile, shown as a share of after-tax-and-transfer income and in 2025 dollars per household. Values are negative by convention (a burden). Use the sidebar to switch pre- vs post-substitution.

spec.title: U.S. Real GDP Effect
spec.subtitle: Percent change in the level of real GDP versus baseline.
spec.source: Bureau of Economic Analysis, The Budget Lab analysis.

figures.body_html: The projected path of real GDP relative to a no-new-tariffs baseline, by quarter.

Alternative Scenarios

TODO (TK): overview copy for the alternative-scenarios comparison.

These figures show the same projected effects as the Default Scenario tab, but across all modeled policy scenarios. Use the View toggle to switch between each scenario's own effects (levels) and its incremental effect relative to the default scenario (change vs. default). Under "change vs. default," the default scenario is the zero reference and does not appear.

Columns show each scenario under both levels and change vs. the default scenario.
